column1: # traceability-verbs.tsv — the registry of supported @-verbs (ADR-047).
# @id traceability-verb-registry
# @implements ADR-047
# This is the single source of truth for "which @-tags does keur traceability
# support?". doc-coverage.sh reads it; adding a verb is a new row here, never a
# script edit. Standard verbs (JSDoc/Doxygen) and keur's own sauce live together.
# Columns (tab-separated; POSIX-greppable; macOS + Linux):
#   verb          the tag, without the leading @
#   source        where it comes from: jsdoc,doxygen,phpdoc = standard; keur = ours
#   kind          decl (declares an @id) | ref (points at one)
#   validated     yes = target must resolve to a declared @id; no = free (path/url/text)
#   deliverable   the deliverable type this verb represents
#   coverage-dim  the measured axis it feeds, or - if recorded-only
# verb        source          kind   validated  deliverable  coverage-dim
id            keur            decl   -          -            -
implements    jsdoc,doxygen   ref    yes        code         concept->code
proves        keur            ref    yes        test         concept->test
shows         keur            ref    yes        demo         concept->demo
explains      keur            ref    yes        guide        concept->guide
see           jsdoc,doxygen   ref    no         related      -
external      keur            ref    no         cross-repo   -
